tips.text: Run your Radiant relics in a radshare squad so each run rolls several times.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Common-part relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra relics for the Blueprint; it is the bottleneck part.
Buy her relics from the Market's Prime Resurgence tab on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
